native_collection_source:
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('.local/e2e');p=out/'schedule-console-replay-checkpoint.json';v=json.loads(p.read_text());assert v['completed'];campaign=v['report'];raw=Path(v['report_path']);assert json.loads(raw.read_text())==campaign
payload={k:campaign[k] for k in ('namespace_id','function_ids','known_instances')};r=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','e2e/schedule-instance-reuse-inspect.py',json.dumps(payload),'--purged'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr[-1000:];native=json.loads(r.stdout);initial=v['native_before'];assert native['completed'] and native['physical']['completed'];assert native['services']==initial['services'];assert native['official_sha256']==initial['official_sha256'];assert native['original_artifacts']==initial['original_artifacts'];assert len(native['embedded_backend'])==34;assert not any(native['counts'].values());assert not native['instances'] and not native['containers'] and not native['leases'];assert not any(native['networks'].values()) and not any(native['channels'].values());assert all(g['retired_at'] for g in native['generations']);assert len(native['functions'])==2 and all(f['purged_at'] for f in native['functions']);assert len(native['firings'])==len(native['invocations'])==6
calls={row['id']:row for row in native['invocations']}
for fire in native['firings']:
 assert fire['state']=='succeeded' and fire['window_at']==campaign['window'];row=calls[fire['invocation_id']];assert row['state']=='succeeded' and row['handler_started'] and row['trigger']=='schedule';assert row['requested_code_hash']==row['resolved_code_hash']==fire['code_hash'];assert row['schedule_firing_id']==fire['id'] and row['schedule_slot']==fire['nominal_at']
reg=json.loads((out/'schedule-console-regressions.json').read_text());assert reg['completed'];assert all(c['before']['source_sha256']==v['before']['source_sha256']==c['after']['source_sha256'] and c['before']['image']==v['before']['image']==c['after']['image'] for c in reg['campaigns'])
for n,s in v['before']['source_sha256'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==s,n
v['native']=native;v['counts']={'groups':19,'console_groups':3,'manual_groups':8,'public_groups':8,'functions_physically_purged':2,'firings':6,'invocations':6,'successful_handlers':6,'source_files_frozen':326,'embedded_backend_files':34,'known_instance_ids_cleaned':len(campaign['known_instances'])};v['native_collection_source']=Path(__file__).read_text();p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'completed':True,'counts':v['counts'],'same_services_configuration_artifacts':True}))
